_what_this_is: Every quoted passage on the page, with either the source's own wording to match against, or a declaration that the marks are the page's own voice and why. A quotation nobody has checked against the source is not a quotation.
_rebuilt: 2026-09-01. The previous file held fourteen entries, four of which were not quotations at all: the extractor paired straight quotation marks left to right with a 25-character floor in the pattern, so a short quoted phrase ('is it better?', fourteen characters) was skipped and its closing mark paired with the next opening one. Everything after ran inverted. One of the four put a phrase in a press release's mouth that the page never attributed to it. extract() now pairs the marks first and applies the floor second.

quotations.quote: Intismeran autogene plus pembrolizumab improves recurrence-free survival versus pembrolizumab alone in resected stage IIB–IV melanoma.
quotations.why: The claim this page scores, formulated by us. It sits in the scoring block as the proposition under assessment, not as anything anyone said. No document is being quoted.

quotations.quote: absolute recurrence risk in that group is lower, so the same hazard ratio delivers a smaller absolute benefit.
quotations.verbatim: The Phase 2b population was stage IIIB-IV; the Phase 3 adds stage IIB and IIC - node-negative disease . Absolute recurrence risk in that group is lower, so the same hazard ratio delivers a smaller absolute benefit.
quotations.why: Morning Glory Sciences' argument that the Phase 3's added population changes what the hazard ratio delivers. Acquired and entered as S009 on 2026-09-01, split out of S006, which had carried this outlet in also_urls while holding a different outlet's article.

quotations.quote: can face risks of recurrence and melanoma-specific mortality similar to those observed in stage III disease.
quotations.verbatim: Patients with resected stage IIB or IIC melanoma can face risks of recurrence and melanoma-specific mortality similar to those observed in stage III disease.
quotations.why: Pharmacy Times' counter-argument about the population the Phase 3 adds. The wording is the fact-check gate's own found_value for verdict c38, recorded VERIFIED against this URL on 2026-08-28, and a WebFetch of the same URL on 2026-09-01 returned the same sentence independently. S010 is nonetheless `blocked` — pharmacytimes.com returns 403 to acquisition — so nobody HOLDS the document, and this quotation stays unattested until somebody does. Two retrievals agreeing is evidence; it is not the bytes.
quotations._wording_on_file: melanoma.html.gate.json, verdict c38, found_value, by the fact-check gate

quotations.quote: will be presented at an upcoming international medical meeting and shared with regulatory authorities.
quotations.verbatim: These data will be presented at an upcoming international medical meeting and shared with regulatory authorities.
quotations.why: The companies' own statement about when the Phase 3 data will appear. Read off S001, whose full text is held.

quotations.verbatim: First and only combination regimen to demonstrate statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements in RFS and DMFS compared to KEYTRUDA alone for these patients in the adjuvant melanoma setting
quotations.why: The only characterisation the release gives of the Phase 3 result. The page previously closed the quotation with a full stop inside the marks; S001 does not end a sentence there, so the stop was ours and now sits outside them.

quotations.quote: a 49% reduction in the hazard of recurrence or death
quotations.why: The page's own restatement of HR 0.510 as a percentage, and the sentence containing it says so: 'a correct restatement of the ratio'. NOTE FOR THE EDITOR: S001 carries the near-identical 'a 49% reduction in the risk of recurrence or death', and this page deliberately writes hazard where the release writes risk. A reader could take these marks as attribution. Removing them would end the ambiguity.

quotations.quote: is it different, in either direction?
quotations.why: The page explaining what a two-sided test asks. Its own words, in the voice of the test.

quotations.verbatim: The primary endpoint is RFS, defined as the time from randomization to any disease recurrence (local, locoregional, regional or distant) as assessed by the investigator, or death due to any cause.
quotations.why: How the release defines the Phase 3 primary endpoint, which is the point the paragraph turns on: clinical judgement rather than central adjudication. Read off S001, whose full text is held.
The null hypothesis, named in plain words so a reader can see what an interval crossing 1.0 leaves open. Nobody said it.

quotations.quote: These subsequent analyses are not intended for formal hypothesis testing (ie, are descriptive only)
quotations.verbatim: These subsequent analyses are not intended for formal hypothesis testing (ie, are descriptive only). The statistical analysis plan prespecified estimation of HRs and 95% CIs using stratified Cox proportional hazards models
quotations.why: The three-year paper's own statement of what its analyses are, added on 2026-09-01 when the source advocate objected that 'cleared the line' implies a formal test the paper says it did not run. Read off S007, held in full.

quotations.quote: designed with approximately 80% power to detect a hazard ratio (HR) of 0.5
quotations.verbatim: The trial was designed with approximately 80% power to detect a hazard ratio (HR) of 0.5 with a one-sided a of 0.10 after 40 RFS events.
quotations.why:
The trial's own prespecified threshold, which decides whether 0.0266 and 0.053 are a win and a near miss or the same result well inside a registered line. Read off S007, held in full.

THE QUOTATION STOPS BEFORE THE ALPHA ON PURPOSE. The paper prints a Greek alpha and the PDF extracts it as the letter 'a', so a page quotation containing the character can never match the bytes we hold. The threshold is stated outside the quotation marks and carried verbatim by Q-12, from a second document that spells it out. Same shape as The Lancet's middle dot: a character, not a fact, deciding whether a check can see something.

quotations.verbatim: Designed with 80% power to detect a hazard ratio of 0.5 with 40 RFS events (with a 1-sided alpha of 0.1 per protocol)
quotations.why: The same threshold, stated independently in the ASCO 2024 presentation. Two held documents agree, which is why the sentence does not rest on one reading.
